body.message:
Good to hear from you! The studio in Upside Living is AED 4,500/month, all-inclusive, no agent fee, and the deposit is AED 1,000 fully refundable within 14 working days after check-out. The price is locked for 3 months from when you confirm.

Regarding the Burj Khalifa view, let me check which specific unit is available and whether it has that view, and I'll come back to you shortly. Here's the listing with photos in the meantime: https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/plp/rent/apartment-for-rent-dubai-business-bay-upside-living-13851875.html

When are you looking to move in?
